The post Missouri Men Accused of Recruiting Homeless to Cash $3,400,000 in Stolen Treasury Checks appeared first on The Daily Hodl.
content: Two men in Missouri have been accused of running a scheme to recruit homeless individuals to cash millions of dollars in stolen Treasury checks. The suspects face multiple federal charges including bank fraud, conspiracy, possession of stolen mail, and aggravated identity theft. The illicit operation involved intercepting checks from the mail and utilizing vulnerable people to cash them.

Under the judgment, Walmart is barred […]
The post Walmart Paying $16,000,000 After California Counties Allege Expired Infant Formula Sales appeared first on The Daily Hodl.
content: Walmart has agreed to pay 16 million dollars to settle allegations by several California counties that the retail giant sold expired infant formula and over-the-counter drugs. District attorneys from multiple counties filed the settlement in Alameda County Superior Court. Under the terms of the judgment, Walmart is barred from continuing these practices and must resolve the compliance issues.
